data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. Thank you for reporting this issue. The 'Failed to register MFA device' error, often seen as MFA-MOB-002 on the mobile app, is a known issue. We recommend that your users complete the MFA setup process via the CloudDesk web app instead. They can do this by going to 'Settings' > 'Security' > 'Multi-Factor Authentication'. Once MFA is configured through the web app, it will function correctly for both web and mobile logins. [T-4667] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
